title: Install and verify Clew
summary: Install and verify Clew under email admission maintenance, migrate legacy application references to Cast jobs with a private backup, and preserve the daily email schedule.

consumers.statement: The authorized local installer and Cell deployment coordinator.

preconditions.statement: A validated committed candidate and compatible Cast, Email and Clockwork interfaces are available. Migration of a nonempty schema-one ledger also requires the Platter opportunity reader. Coordinated mutations require drained run-owned email maintenance; migration requires the sole owned hold.

inputs.statement: Use deploy.sh plan clew then deploy.sh clew from committed local main. The boolean daily_email_enabled setting changes daily intent; omission preserves it. Direct install accepts absolute --binary, --bundle and optional --home. schedule-definition requires existing state and a new absolute output file.

outputs.statement: The selected immutable release contains clew, clew-install and the matching Chancery provider. Coordinated configure initializes empty schema-two state or migrates schema one with a private consistent backup and exact legacy aliases.

data_semantics.statement: Installation selects programs and initializes or migrates ledger state. It creates no application reports or supplied statuses. Migration preserves original rows, write IDs, timestamps, sequence, corrections and retractions; Platter supplies only the exact legacy-reference-to-Cast-ID mapping.

identity_and_units.statement: Content hashes identify immutable releases; package version, provider contract and database schema are separate identities.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verification checks selected installed bytes, local ledger integrity and the complete retained Cast snapshot interface at that invocation. Migration requires a mapping for every legacy ledger reference and refuses missing or colliding mappings. It establishes no future availability.

access.statement: The current user owns installation selectors and private ledger state.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The shared file transaction selects commands and provider atomically. Lifecycle captures, suspends and drains email work, prepares the exact disabled definition, then restores enabled intent after releasing its hold. Migration serializes ledger writes, creates a new private schema-one SQLite backup, and commits schema and aliases in one transaction. Old schema-one writers are then rejected. Failure halts, frozen email bytes, keys and receipts remain intact.

operational_limits.statement: There is no completion-time guarantee. Compatible schema-two readers and short SQLite writers can finish across program selection. Schema-one migration uses a separate guarded write boundary and never overwrites an earlier backup.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Only cell-install-v2 releases, ledger schema two and email schema one are supported. Contract three adds guarded migration from ledger schema one. Ordinary commands and direct installation do not migrate state. Recovery must use a compatible program and ledger pair; there is no automatic downgrade. Preserve email delivery records across recovery.

reliances.statement: Clew requires the complete Cast snapshot reader for first-job admission, search, email context and deployment verification.
Migration of a nonempty schema-one ledger reads retained Platter opportunities to map each legacy reference to its exact Cast job ID. Ordinary schema-two work does not need Platter.
Email submits the unchanged payload and stable key to the fixed recipient.
Clockwork activates the installed runner and enforces scheduling failure halts.

use_when: Installing, checking or recovering the Clew command and private ledger.
do_not_use_when: Recording an application update or changing Platter preparation.
outcome: Verified installed Clew commands, provider and compatible empty or existing ledger.
effects: Program deployment selects immutable files and initializes a missing ledger or migrates schema one under maintenance with a private consistent backup. Existing ledger rows and exact retry identities remain intact.
The coordinator holds email admission and suspends scheduling while preparing the selected release. Activation restores captured or explicitly supplied intent without approving a halt.
authority: Clew owns its installation and ledger; the shared coordinator owns deployment ordering.
Clockwork owns schedule enforcement; enabling daily_email_enabled explicitly grants standing authority for the Clew digest.
success: Installed bytes match the selected candidate, schema-two ledger integrity passes and the complete retained Cast snapshot interface succeeds.
failure_and_recovery: File recovery preserves ledger state and must not claim an incompatible old program can operate schema two. Missing or colliding migration mappings stop the upgrade. Preserve the private schema-one backup and unresolved installation evidence. Unsupported or nonempty foreign state fails.
Retain email occurrences and uncertain acceptance across recovery. Resolve product and schedule selection before releasing run-owned admission; never erase or approve existing failure incidents.
privacy: Private ledger state is outside source and installation releases.
does_not_authorize: Adding application records, deleting history, immediate test mail, implicit first-time schedule enablement, or approval of a failure halt.
